PZZ700-010830-
1216 PM PDT Sat Oct 31 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1020 mb high was over New Mexico and a 1007 mb low 
was 800 miles southwest of San Diego. Weak to moderate onshore 
flow will continue through Sunday morning. Winds will increase
Sunday afternoon and evening with peak gusts of 20 to 25 kt
expected in the Outer Coastal waters. There is also a slight 
chance of thunderstorms Saturday night and Sunday morning as a 
storm system moves through the region. Weak offshore flow in the 
morning will alternate with afternoon onshore flow starting 
Monday.
